# FetchShelf dependency snapshot

This directory contains the tracked source of `silencoo/TikTok-Api` commit
`1fab904e446bd0e343a6127edb33e80ecc50cad5`, recovered from the working NAS
deployment on 2026-10-29. It replaces a gitlink whose commit was unavailable
from GitHub and whose `.gitmodules` mapping was missing.

The original 101 tracked files are preserved, including the MIT license.
The production runtime matched that source after normalizing line endings.
No Git submodule initialization or private NAS access is needed to build.

Upstream: https://github.com/silencoo/TikTok-Api
Original project: https://github.com/davidteather/TikTok-Api

Update this snapshot deliberately, review the changes, and update the commit
record here. Do not replace it with an unpinned remote checkout at build time.
